meaning: Sphyrna, probably a misspelling of Greek sphyraina “hammerfish” (from sphyra “hammer”); mokarran, an Arabic name for this shark, possibly from miqrn “horned”, for the shape of its head
description: The largest hammerhead. Its head is wide and almost straight across the front, and its tall, sickle-shaped first dorsal fin gives it away from a distance. It hunts stingrays, pinning them to the seabed with the edge of its head.
eats: Stingrays, fish, squid and other sharks
